previous_goal_turn_classification: progress: scoped callback repair pushed to main and exact-SHA Swift 6.3.3 complete CI passed
purpose: Test whether a single generic context instruction reduces shared natural code-switch translation while preserving predeclared controls; no prompt search or production change
hypothesis: The unchanged Qwen3-ASR model may use a non-answer-bearing system context to preserve original-language text where the empty-context native/Python references translate Chinese into English. Unsupported instruction-following behavior is possible and will be measured rather than assumed.
context_prompt: Transcribe all speech verbatim in its original language. Preserve code-switching. Do not translate, summarize, or add words.

data.selection: Same four previously published failures plus first/last metadata rows for each of zh/en/mixed. No new output-dependent selection; unchanged original PCM/WAV, audio order, references and normalization.
data.attribution: ASCEND, Lovenia et al., LREC 2022, HKUST CAiRE

execution.order: Ten unchanged Python baselines in metadata order, then ten candidate calls in the same order using the same model instance; clear MLX cache between calls. All model methods unmodified.
execution.model_hash_policy: Reuse fixed model identity; compare original protected model/frozen file metadata and current tracked-source digests; no repeated whole-model hashing.

qualification.translation_targets: Both retained translation cases must reduce author-tokenized edits, preserve all original Han characters in order and preserve English reference words; script presence alone is insufficient.
qualification.controls: No increased author-tokenized edit count in any of the six independent controls or the two other known-failure controls.
qualification.action_if_failed: Close pilot without changing defaults, broadening cohort, or searching more prompts. Retain all results.
qualification.action_if_passed: Preliminary qualification only. A separate fixed full-cohort native candidate, original 100-corpus/per-case gates and target latency/quality evidence are required before adoption. No gate closes from this pilot.

analysis.independent_distance: Recompute all twenty distances with an independently implemented full matrix.
analysis.timing: Internal Python generation timings are not comparable to native HTTP or microphone end-to-end latency.
